$comment: Role -> slot keys of the Joomla content contracts (content-map.json), read from the release named in `checked`. Each role lists groups: a group is written whole or not at all. Fields: text/title/label are text slots, href a url slot. Only the default-language (en-GB) modules are named: a site's other editions are translated from them by the build.

notes.hero: Home (menuItem-247, layout od-landing) carries two heroes: OpenDesign module-228 (od-landing-hero) and module-193 (masthead); both are written.
notes.cards: The home 'value' cards (module-231): a heading and a paragraph each, nothing else. Product carousel (214) is not used: each slide has a kicker label with no source; Product tabs (215) are process steps.

notes.hero: module-441's title-accent (441.2) is left to the planner: Joomla cannot empty it, and the name alone is the title.
notes.cards: About 'What we do' cards (module-838): a title and a description each. Services 844-848 hold stats, steps and priced rows: no dish fits them.
notes.languages: The ru-RU copies (861+, 868+, 461+) are not named: default language only.
